subject: HANDOFF: ticket08 universal Flex Deck — bounded companion feasible; universal replacement unproven
body: Ticket08 research complete for required 2 cycles. Cycle1 5/5 SOURCE/MODEL boundary oracle falsified reuse of the passive fold overlay as a universal native-like touchpad. Cycle2 16/16 revised adversarial MODEL tests support a host/capability-tiered design. Disposition requested from Manager: CONTINUE only as isolated prototype. Near-term safe target is Duo companion controls with public split/adjacent host probe when system action exists, compact nonfocusable overlay fallback, explicit opt-in gesture/semantic tiers, and no automatic Shizuku/raw-input escalation. Samsung already provides Fold7 Flex Mode panel/touchpad for selected/supported apps, so a generic touchpad alone duplicates native capability. Physical gates remain: One UI split/adjacent behavior, focus/IME continuity, gesture cancellation, posture discrimination, Samsung panel coexistence, privacy and endurance. Do NOT mark universal/production-ready from this handoff.
requested_manager_disposition: REVIEW_CONTINUE_REVISE_DEFER_OR_REJECT; production promotion prohibited without field evidence
